snippet.title: The Falconeer: Warrior Edition -  Launch Trailer | PS5, PS4
snippet.description:
Soar through the skies aboard a majestic warbird, explore a stunning oceanic world and engage in epic aerial dogfights, in this BAFTA-nominated air combat game from solo developer, Tomas Sala. 

Available August 5 on PlayStation 5, and PlayStation 4.

WishList Now: bit.ly/379dgeN
Pre-Order a Physical Copy: https://wiredproductions.com/games/the-falconeer/
Learn More: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10002246/
